sources.entry: hermes-agent - An adaptive personal AI assistant that grows with you.

Hermes Agent *(NousResearch)* — The self-improving AI agent. Builds reusable skills from experience and improves them during use, giving it a compounding learning loop. Persistent cross-session memory (SQLite + FTS5), multi-platform gateway (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, CLI), 40+ built-in tools, and RL/trajectory-generation support via Atropos. One-line install. MIT. → Website · awe

summary.one_liner: Hermes Agent is a self-improving personal AI assistant from Nous Research that creates and refines skills from experience, remembers past sessions, and runs across terminal and messaging platforms.
summary.what_it_does: Hermes Agent is a terminal and messaging AI agent that works with many model providers, switchable via `hermes model`. It has a full terminal UI (multiline editing, slash-command autocomplete, streaming tool output) and a single gateway process that serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and CLI, with voice memo transcription. Its learning loop stores agent-curated memory, creates skills after complex tasks, improves them during use, and searches past sessions with FTS5 and LLM summarization. A built-in cron scheduler delivers unattended tasks to any platform. It can spawn subagents, runs in six terminal backends (local, Docker, SSH, Modal, Daytona, Vercel Sandbox) plus plugin backends, and supports batch trajectory generation for training tool-calling models.
use_cases: personal AI assistant reachable from chat apps
running an always-on agent on a cheap VPS or cloud VM
scheduled daily reports and nightly backups via natural language
building reusable agent skills over time
generating agent trajectories for training tool-calling models

notable: Closed learning loop: creates skills after complex tasks and improves them during use
Cross-session memory with FTS5 session search and LLM summarization
Single gateway process serving Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and CLI
Serverless backends (Daytona, Modal) that hibernate when idle
Nous Portal subscription option bundles model, web search, image generation, TTS, and cloud browser
caveats: Native Windows installer is a separate path; the README also notes a possible antivirus false positive on the bundled uv.exe
Nous Portal bundled tools are a paid subscription; bringing your own keys is also supported
